description: This file declares the CfConnectionObserverFactory class, which implements a factory for creating connection observers in a WebRTC-based system. It manages various handlers and controllers related to WebRTC connections, including display, camera, sensors, and lights observers.

classes.name: CfConnectionObserverFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing WebRTC connection observers, integrating various input, display, camera, sensors, and lights handlers.

methods.name: CfConnectionObserverFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with input, kernel log, sensors, and lights handlers.

methods.name: CreateObserver
methods.description: Creates and returns a new WebRTC connection observer.

methods.name: AddCustomActionServer
methods.description: Associates a custom action server with specific commands.

methods.name: SetDisplayHandler
methods.description: Sets the display handler for the connection observer.

methods.name: SetCameraHandler
methods.description: Sets the camera controller for the connection observer.
